author: yathAg
title: GPU prepare_primitive_fusing clang-tidy braces-around-statements errors
signature: clang-tidy readability-braces-around-statements error if statement missing braces treated as warning as error|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build-gpu / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: Cmake build with clang-tidy enabled fails: two single-statement if-bodies without braces in prepare_primitive_fusing.cpp trigger readability-braces-around-statements, promoted to error by -Werror

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_clang_tidy
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check fails because Build-gpu / Build failed

key_errors:
2 warnings treated as errors
ninja: build stopped: cannot make progress due to previous errors.
root_cause: PR #39751 modifies src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/graph_optimizer/prepare_primitive_fusing.cpp inside the fuse_constant_transposes logic (the fix for rank-3 FC weight transposes) and introduces two single-line 'if (...) continue;' statements without braces around the body. The GPU clang-tidy CI job enables readability-braces-around-statements and treats clang-tidy warnings as errors, so these unbraced single-statement if-bodies fail the build at lines 1694 and 1703. This is the same recurring clang-tidy braces style violation this doctor has already recorded 4 times for other GPU-component PRs in the last ~12 hours (signature a4282c65071120e2), confirming it is a common, easily-avoided style mistake rather than a flaky or infra issue.
reproduction_steps: Build with clang-tidy enabled: cmake -DENABLE_CLANG_TIDY=ON ... && ninja openvino_intel_gpu_graph (or run clang-tidy-18 directly on src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/graph_optimizer/prepare_primitive_fusing.cpp with the readability-braces-around-statements check enabled and -Werror on warnings-as-errors) to reproduce the two reported errors at lines 1694 and 1703.
recommended_actions: Add braces around the single-statement bodies of 'if (const_pshape.is_dynamic()) continue;' (line 1694) and 'if (!data_in_outer_dims) continue;' (line 1703) in src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/graph_optimizer/prepare_primitive_fusing.cpp
Re-run the clang-tidy build locally before pushing to catch this class of style violation earlier
Run clang-format/clang-tidy auto-fix locally (clang-tidy -fix) on changed files before submitting GPU-plugin PRs
prevention_strategies: Enable a pre-commit or local clang-tidy check (matching the CI's enabled checks, including readability-braces-around-statements) for src/plugins/intel_gpu changes before pushing. Consider a lightweight CI pre-check or editor lint rule that flags brace-less single-statement if/for/while bodies in new/changed lines, since this specific check has now recurred 5 times across unrelated PRs in the same day.
historical_context: This exact failure signature (clang-tidy readability-braces-around-statements / Code Issue) has now been recorded 5 times today (2026-11-18) across PRs #39751 (this run), #39853, #38575, and #38641, all touching GPU-plugin code. This is a recurring, easily fixable style issue rather than an infrastructure problem; escalating via notify_teams_recurring.
